textures.name: Vln I, Vln II, Vla, Vc, Cb
textures.function: Sustained textures (tremolo, pedal, divisi); melody in accumulation passages

textures.name: 2 Fl, 2 Ob, 2 Cl, 2 Bsn
textures.function: Solo melodic fragments; atmospheric color; rarely in full choir

textures.name: 4 Hn, 3 Tpt, 3 Tbn
textures.function: Sustained pedals, chorale, climactic theme statements

textures.name: Frozen pedal
textures.function: Bass sustains; upper strings tremolo pp; solo wind fragment

textures.name: String tremolo shimmer
textures.function: Divided strings sustain shifting chords, ppp-pp

textures.name: Brass chorale
textures.function: 4 horns + 3 trombones in hymn-like sustained chords

textures.name: Solo over void
textures.function: Single instrument (flute, oboe, cor anglais) with minimal or no accompaniment
textures.genre: Fragment-seed passages; the melody alone in space

textures.name: Accumulative tutti
textures.function: Instruments enter one by one over 16–32 bars; texture builds from ppp to ff

textures.name: Rhythmic unison
textures.function: Full orchestra on a single rhythmic figure, often repeated
